attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Only CE programs offered through APA-approved sponsors (Board renewal page); 251 CMR 4.00 also allows publication of books, chapters or refereed articles for up to 10 hours
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep proof of completion; Board may request verification for up to two prior renewal periods.
rules.notes: Licenses expire June 30 of even years. Board-approved domestic and sexual violence training is required once to renew (credited as 2 CE in that cycle). Non-compliance: discipline, fine and extra CE. Applies to all psychologist license types (HSP, non-provider).
